resource.name: Art Social Wellbeing Club — Hounslow
resource.description: A relaxed weekly art and wellbeing club with painting, drawing, sewing, embroidery, crafts, refreshments and time to meet other people.
resource.who: Local residents, particularly older people, adults with disabilities or additional needs, and anyone who wants creative activity, wellbeing and social connection.
resource.access: Drop in on Tuesdays from 10.30am to 12.30pm at Brabazon Community Centre, 106 Brabazon Road, Hounslow TW5 9LT. Call 07903 215946 for more information.
resource.check: The sessions are listed as free and open to everyone. Confirm that the session is running, and ask about accessibility or other support before travelling.
resource.coverage: Brabazon Community Centre in Hounslow; aimed at local residents.

sources.note: The current provider page confirms the weekly Hounslow club, audience, creative activities, wellbeing purpose, venue and Tuesday time.
Ealing and Hounslow CVS confirms that the club is free, open to everyone, welcomes drop-ins and publishes the venue, time and contact number.

candidates.evidence: Current provider and local voluntary-sector pages describe the same ongoing weekly club, its creative activities, inclusive access, free status and Hounslow contact route.
candidates.limitations: Capacity, detailed accessibility, holiday closures and individual support availability are not published. Session arrangements may change at short notice.

resource.check: Services are free to eligible residents. Ask the team to confirm eligibility, assessment, current availability, accessibility and the support offered.

candidates.limitations: Eligibility and age rules differ between services. The page does not publish assessment times, capacity, waiting times or the exact activities currently available.
